$comment: Single source of truth for the build matrix. Renovate bumps base digests, pgvector and pg_search; humans change status/default. A major sets "pg_search": false while ParadeDB ships no package for it, and "<extension>": false (e.g. "age": false) while PGDG ships no postgresql-<major>-<extension> package.

dictionaries.$comment: Full-text search dictionaries in tsearch_data. Hunspell files come from the Debian trixie packages (exact versions in manifest.txt); the stop lists are vendored in tsearch_data/ from these commits.
